title: The Joust
idea: Sir Bonk rears on his hobby horse (NEIGH!) and gallops at Wibou; Wibou's shuriken plink off the armour, the lance unhorses Wibou (BONK!) and Sir Bonk rears proudly before the horse poofs away. Camera on Bonk's front three-quarter.
feedback: Owner 2026-10-28: weak execution but keep the idea: it shows Sir Bonk's R (the ability is great) and the armour shrugging off a projectile is a good beat. Redo closer and readable: see the hobby horse, the shuriken plinking off the armour, and Wibou big when the lance hits.
